purpose: 12-dimension A-F diagnostic mapping an organisation's cryptographic estate and sector to the CNSA 2.0 / EU-2030 / G7 / DORA post-quantum milestones, flagging the end-2026 EU crypto-inventory deadline. Routes to the existing pqc-migration chain for inventory/HNDL/roadmap/agility and to the new protocol chains (TLS/PKI, SWIFT/ISO 20022, FIDO, blockchain).
